privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: YORewards helps you collect digital loyalty stamps. This policy explains what we collect and how we protect your data.

dataCollected.title: What we collect
dataCollected.body: Phone number, display name, loyalty card progress, stamp and redemption history, and basic device/browser data needed to run the app.

hosting.title: Where data is stored
hosting.body: Data is hosted in Supabase EU West (Frankfurt, Germany). We use this region to meet GDPR requirements for users in Nepal and Finland.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. We will respond to verified requests within a reasonable time.

deletion.title: Account deletion
deletion.body: To delete your account and associated data, use Request data deletion on your profile or email us at the address below.
